Registered arrays obey sequence|canonical-set|canonical-order|utf8|path|numeric|ordinal|predicate|ruleId|waiverId|{by:[...]}; unique sort keys except sequence and canonical-order
payloadSchemaDigest is SHA256 of the named full document bytes; payload validates at the row selector; unregistered key refuses; codec C
